name: Orange Jordan Marj Al-Hammam Data Center
notes: Operational Tier III-certified colocation/hosting data center in Marj Al-Hammam, Amman; A for Orange hosting brochure and Uptime certification record; directory power claims (e.g. 3.6 MW per inflect listing) are C-grade unverified.

name: Orange Jordan Hashem Data Center
notes: Hashem Data Center in the Medical City area of Amman earned Uptime Institute Tier III Certification of Design Documents (March 2025); facility operating as Orange hosting site; constructed-facility certification status and capacity not yet confirmed.

name: Zain Jordan The Bunker
notes: Operational Uptime Tier III data and disaster-recovery center, ~4,300 sqm, 12 m underground, at King Hussein Business Park, Amman; 99.982% availability claim; directory 2 MW figure is C-grade unverified.

name: Umniah Dahiyat Al-Rasheed Data Center (Al-Rashid colocation room)
notes: Operational colocation facility in Dahiyat Al-Rasheed, Amman; first and only in Jordan with Uptime Tier III Constructed Facility certification (99.982% examined availability claim); industrial power grid connection; capacity not public.

name: Umniah South Amman data center (new Tier III project)
notes: Umniah official page references a new South Amman data center and Trismart announced commencement of a new Tier III data center in Amman; construction/operational status and relationship to Dahiyat Al-Rasheed still to be verified.

name: NITC / MoDEE government hosting and national cloud
developer: National Information Technology Center (NITC) / Ministry of Digital Economy (MoDEE)
notes: Government/institutional hosting for e-government and national cloud programs, Amman (exact site not public); A for policy/program, B/C for facility evidence; counted as institutional, not commercial colo.

name: Aqaba Digital Hub (ADH) Mega Data Center - Data Hall 1 & CLS
notes: Jordan's largest carrier-neutral Tier III data center in Aqaba, ~17,000 sqm with up to 12 MW operational capacity per inauguration coverage (announced ceiling, not delivered IT load); EBRD JOD10m/EU-supported loan finances fit-out and expansion incl. second hall; 6 MW initial IT load per AI-DC index (C).

name: Aqaba Digital Hub (ADH) City Data Center
notes: Tier III-certified city-center carrier-neutral colocation/hosting/managed-services facility in Aqaba, active since 2020; treated as a distinct site from the Mega Data Center per ADH pages; capacity not publicly stated.

name: Orange Jordan Ain Al-Basha Data Center
notes: Inaugurated 28 May 2025 under patronage of Minister of Digital Economy at the former Al-Baqa'a Satellite Station site, Ain Al-Basha, Balqa; designed/expandable to 500 racks and 5 MW total capacity (announced capacity, not delivered load).
